title: SG-5.5 Phaser scene is a thin wrapper over the generic scene builder
summary: BootScene builds all scene objects through buildScene from bundled content, with no hardcoded objects
description: Context: BootScene (game/frontend/src/phaser/BootScene.ts) preloads assets and builds effects, but it never calls buildScene, and no Phaser-backed RenderContext exists. Desired behavior: BootScene delegates object creation to the engine's buildScene using a Phaser RenderContext and the bundled bedroom scene content. Expected result: every object on screen comes from content, and BootScene names no object id or asset id. Why: future AI cycles must add or replace objects by editing content only.
acceptance_criteria: Given the bundled bedroom scene, when BootScene.create runs, then buildScene is called once with that scene and a Phaser-backed RenderContext
Given BootScene.ts and the Phaser render context source, when scanned, then neither contains a bedroom object id or asset id literal
Given a shared-store state change, when it fires, then every built SceneObject receives sync(state)
Given BootScene shutdown, when it fires, then every SceneObject is destroyed and the store subscription is removed

in_scope: BootScene wiring of buildScene, state sync and cleanup
Forwarding object clicks to the typed phaserToReact bus
out_of_scope: New assets or new scene content
preserve: Existing preload, fallback texture and effects wiring in BootScene
Existing buildScene, SceneObject and layerDepth behavior
Typed event bus contract in events.ts

technical_constraints: Engine modules under game/src/engine must not import Phaser
Game state stays in the Zustand store, BootScene keeps no copy
non_functional: Pixel-art friendly rendering: no smoothing on sprites
